answer_quote: Yes. In this section the muscular media (the eosinophilic pink band on the right) is well developed and thick on the side *opposite* the lesion, but it becomes progressively attenuated and fragmented beneath the bulky, lipid‑rich (yellow) plaque on the left.
note: 答案明确为是，且图像显示斑块下中膜变薄；但后续关于慢性炎症、脂质过氧化及特定基质金属蛋白酶机制不能由该图像确认，解释整体正确性记null。
